description: Base Hydrographie : Points d'eau is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by IGN. Ce jeu de données détaille les sources (captée ou non), points de production d’eau (pompage, forage, puits,...) ou points de stockage d’eau de petite dimension (citerne, abreuvoir, lavoir, bassin) présents dans le thème Hydrographie de le BD TOPO ® Le thème Hydrographie de le BD TOPO ® contient le réseau hydrographique: les cours d’eau, les ... Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are Eau douce, Point, Source, BD Topo. The portal shows 1,350 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2019-07-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open License v1.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
